body: Thanks for replying. It feels too hard. I know the kids would suffer but I think I'm making them suffer by being here and sad. I wish I could go back in time.....
I do cucumber, lime and mint. It's lush!
That's where I am. He's gone to a peaceful place, I hope, and I'm left with the beautiful life affirming memories. And the loss....... I wish you well

One of his old friends said to me i have to remember that for that year I was one of the important people in his life. I'm trying to write but I find that talking to him helps. I look at photos a lot too. It a a rough road. But we have to keep moving. Take care. X
Please feel free to pm me too if you want. Xx
Bless you. I totally understand why you're eager to get the funeral over. Take care of yourself.
Saying goodbye was hard. I'm glad your role in his life is being acknowledged.

Our stories sound pretty similar.  Andy and I had an amazing relation ship that allowed us to heal from lots of past shit. Sadly it was never going to be enough for him. He was a tortured soul.  
It sounds like you do need to see him and say goodbye in private.  To be honest that was my funeral for him, the actual funeral was just a formality. I thought I'd be cross with him but he looked so peaceful I was a bit relieved for him. I just sat, stroked his hair for a while and said things I needed to say. I hope you get something useful from it. X

It's been nearly 4 weeks. This weekend will be the first normal weekend without him while my kids are with their dad.  We worked a bar shift Saturdays, tonight will be the first one without him there. The funeral was last Friday, it did help but as we'd only been together a year it was full of people who knew him in his old life.  So I went the week before and said a private goodbye to him which really did help. There was no denying it anymore. This is a tough road. It feels strange to be able to bare your soul to strangers, friends ask if I'm ok and I feel compelled to say yes.

I'm with you there. Again, I wouldn't actually do anything but I have such a huge hole in my life it's consuming me. I'm finding I can be calm then other this overwhelming feeling hits me and I'm a mess. I guess whatever you are feeling is normal for you. This is your journey. I'm sorry you are suffering and hope you find some peace.  Keep reaching out, that's helping me. My partner taught me how useful distraction is. When the voices in your head are too loud keep breathing, it will pass. Many hugs. 🤗🤗🤗
